title: Dynamic Player
description: A now-playing pill that blooms into a full player when you hover or click it, and folds back when you leave. Width, height, corners and the cover ride one spring, so you can catch it mid-morph; the glow and the ring around it are drawn from the album art and breathe with the beat.
intent: One ink shape that morphs between a pill and a player on a retargetable spring, lit by its own cover.
